doc_friction.issue: Earlier registrations counted every syllable of a pitch-and-length cell as its own trial, but render.mjs seeds a note's noise from pitch and length, so a cell's syllables share one burst draw (97% of p-burst variance lies between cells); predicted rates were overrated. This round states its expectation in cells; the next registrations should too.

writeups: ventures/chant-forge/README.md (A p's burst read as a k)
notes: Flagship chant-forge (allocate row 8). Diagnosed V's p-as-k misses: the energy above 1 kHz is the 8 ms noise burst's own random spectrum (alone: 22-65% above 1 kHz, 10th-90th pct), set per cell by the seed; voiceless velars read >=0.99. Rule readCoda voicelessLow (0.9 for voiceless stops), dev A-V +31 cells none lost; pre-registered (commit 718f66e99) before held-out part W ran; W: p as k 18 to 0, p exact 100 to 118 of 120, everything else identical: held, made default. Checks: node eval/coda-check.mjs full report rebuilt (9.5 min) matches the dev figures; python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py chant-forge: ok, 290 tests, 0 failed; post front matter/links/similarity checks clean; portfolio/router/validate.py valid.
